paragraphs: Regroup sells a mass notification platform that organizations use for emergency alerts and for everyday operational messages in one place. Government buyers use it to reach residents quickly and to improve communication among their own staff.

Alerts go out by text message, email, voice call, and social media. Messages can be aimed at a specific area through geofencing. Recipients can reply, so senders learn who is safe and who needs help. The platform also connects to federal and regional public warning systems. For larger incidents, a dashboard gives one interface for monitoring every part of an event as it unfolds.

Regroup dates its service to 2006. The company says onboarding, unlimited training, and around the clock support come at no extra cost. Comments published on the site come from county emergency management offices, among other customers. Schools and campuses are another audience, with alerts for lockdowns and similar emergencies.
